description: This file is a Node.js script written in JavaScript, intended for automation tasks related to build, snapshot, and runtime analysis within a software project. It includes functions for process control, filesystem operations, build requirement resolution, and benchmarking specific to project directories like 'dist' and 'dist-runtime'.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and overrides default options accordingly.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Creates a directory and its parent directories if they do not exist.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes in a file path.

methods.name: listTreeEntries
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of directory entries under a specified root directory.

methods.name: humanBytes
methods.description: Converts a number of bytes into a human-readable string (e.g., KB, MB).

methods.name: snapshotTree
methods.description: Generates a snapshot of directory state including file counts and total size.

methods.name: writeSnapshot
methods.description: Creates snapshot files for project directories, including paths and stats.

methods.name: runCheckedCommand
methods.description: Executes a system command and throws an error if it fails.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Returns a Promise that resolves after a specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: buildTimedWatchCommand
methods.description: Constructs a command to run a watch process with timing.

methods.name: parseTimingFile
methods.description: Parses timing information from a file generated by the /usr/bin/time command.

methods.name: runTimedWatch
methods.description: Runs a watch process with timing and handles termination signals.

methods.name: parsePathFile
methods.description: Reads a list of paths from a text file.

methods.name: writeDiffArtifacts
methods.description: Computes differences between directory snapshots and writes added and removed paths.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Logs an error message to stderr.

methods.name: detectWatchBuildReason
methods.description: Analyzes stdout/stderr to determine the reason the watch process triggered a build.

methods.name: buildRunNodeDeps
methods.description: Prepares environment variables and paths for running build dependencies.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates build, snapshot, run, and analysis steps.
